item.title: [SwiftHFR] Topic lists: no refresh button in the top bar, the pull refreshes (#1206)
item.body:
Closes #1206
Claim: cloud/fb-quickwins-sonnet
Author model: Sonnet 5.5 (cloud/fb-quickwins-sonnet)
Reviewer model: Opus 5.5 (cloud/r1208-opus, round 1: REQUEST CHANGES, fixed in the head; round 2 pending)

### Problem
The topic lists' top bar carried a refresh button (legacy's `ToolbarRefreshIcon`, ported by #770) next to « + » and, on Favoris, « Non lus / Tous ». Operator feedback of 2026-11-18: a lighter bar, refresh by pulling.

### Change
- `TopicListView`: the refresh `Button` (and its `canRefresh` gate) is removed from the trailing toolbar group of every list the view serves (Favoris, Drapeaux, category lists, sub-forums). `.refreshable { await model.refresh() }` is untouched.
- `TopicListModel.canRefresh` (only the button used it) and its test `theRefreshButtonIsDisabledOnlyWhileALoadRuns` are removed.
- `ToolbarRefreshIcon` is still used by `BookmarksView` (out of scope); no other topic-list screen shares this toolbar.
- Title pill untouched (system centring, operator rule of #1070); whether it centres on the screen with one trailing button less is a screenshot for the device check (#893).
- Docs: the LOT-147 spec line and its `LOTS.md` row now target "Actualiser" at the bottom of the cover screen on Catégories and Messages only (topic lists and Favoris have no button, review round 1).
- Not in this PR: growing icon, haptic, threshold, bottom pull (#1207).

### Tests
`TopicListToolbarTests` (new, written first): a pushed category list asserts no trailing item; Favoris asserts the only trailing item is « Non lus / Tous » (positive control). The probe waits for the bar to settle (two identical reads). The red run on the previous code is reasoned, not run (Linux); `compile-check` runs on the head.

### Ledger

```gap-edit
GAP-025
SwiftHFR final: Pull to refresh reloads the page on screen, rows kept, retry banner on failure; the topic lists' top bar has no refresh button (#1206, operator feedback 2026-11-18).
Lot/Feat: LOT-082, #1206
Gap: UX change
Source: new UX: operator
H.1: b·operator
```

```gap-edit
GAP-713
SwiftHFR final: The intended placement: "Actualiser" at the bottom on Catégories and Messages, and "Retour" on pushed views, on the cover screen (LOT-147, M4); a forum's topic list and Favoris have no "Actualiser" button (a pull refreshes them, #1206); legacy's top placement on Catégories and Messages is not ported. Inline titles only if SwiftHFR hangs too (#681).
```

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, cloud/r1208-opus, round 1): REQUEST CHANGES** — head 8411ce0f

1. **Medium, PR body `### Ledger` (GAP-025, `docs/migration/GAP-LEGACY-VS-SWIFT.md:51`).** The `gap-edit` moves the row to `UX change` / `new UX: operator` but leaves H.1 at `a`. By the file's own legend (`:9-16`), an operator-decided UX change is `b·operator`, which is what the other `UX change | new UX: operator` rows carry. Once folded, the generated H.1 counts would list this as a plain port. **Fix:** add `H.1: b·operator`, and `#1206` to the lots cell. #1209 edits the same row and has the same gap, so tell its author too.
2. **Medium, GAP-713 (`GAP-LEGACY-VS-SWIFT.md:256`), `docs/lots/LOT-147-duo-ipad-columns.md:56`, `docs/LOTS.md:264` (LOT-147 row).** All three still set the SwiftHFR target as "Actualiser at the bottom on all four lists" (Catégories, a forum's topic list, Favoris, Messages) on the Duo cover screen. After this PR, the topic list and Favoris have no refresh button at all. Whoever implements LOT-147 (#237, open) will put a button back on those lists, against #1206 (L08/L09). **Fix:** a `gap-edit` on GAP-713 ("Actualiser" at the bottom on Catégories and Messages only; the topic lists refresh on a pull, #1206), plus the matching line in the LOT-147 spec and its `LOTS.md` row.
3. **Low, `App/SwiftHFRTests/TopicListToolbarTests.swift:54-77`.** The "fails on the previous code" claim has only been reasoned, never run (L01). The category test stops waiting as soon as the leading item shows (`ready: { $0.leading > 0 }`), so a trailing group installed one frame later would let the old code pass. The `+` item and Drapeaux are not pinned either: no test hosts a list with a composer. **Fix:** wait for the bar to settle (two identical reads in a row), and record the red run on the Mac or in CI.
4. **Detail, `TopicListView.swift:326-335`.** `ToolbarRefreshIcon` no longer has a user in this file; its only caller is `BookmarksView.swift:51`. Its doc comment is still accurate. Moving it next to its user is optional.

**Vérifié:** the diff at 8411ce0f; no remaining `canRefresh` in `App/`; `Synchronization`/`Mutex` no longer used in `TopicListModelTests`; « Non lus / Tous » and `+` still in the trailing group, `.refreshable` unchanged; `ToolbarRefreshIcon` still used by BookmarksView; `favorites` is non-nil only on Favoris/Drapeaux (`TopicListModel.swift:146`), so the Favoris test has a real positive control; `swiftlint lint --strict` on the 4 touched files: clean; `ledger.py check-body --file <live body> --pr 1208`: 1 block ok. App tests not run (Linux).

**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, cloud/r1208-opus, round 2): APPROVE** — head f8c6eb2b

Round 1 findings, re-checked:
- (1) Fixed. The GAP-025 gap-edit now carries `H.1: b·operator`, `Lot/Feat: LOT-082, #1206`, `Gap: UX change` and `Source: new UX: operator`.
- (2) Fixed. The GAP-713 gap-edit, LOT-147 spec line 56 and the LOT-147 row of `LOTS.md` now limit Actualiser to Catégories and Messages, and say the topic lists and Favoris have none because a pull refreshes them (#1206). The GAP-713 edit replaces only the SwiftHFR-final cell; the legacy cell still describes 87fe0d1c correctly.
- (3) Fixed. `bar(of:ready:)` stops only when `ready` holds and two reads in a row (50 ms apart) give the same counts; otherwise it gives up after 100 reads. The tests cannot pass trivially:
  - On the old code the category list trails the refresh button (trailing 1, the test wants 0), and Favoris trails the filter plus refresh (2, the test wants 1).
  - If the bar never installs, `leading > 0` fails the category test.
  - In the category test, the root screen's empty item is never "ready", so only the pushed list's bar is read.

Findings (none blocking):
1. Detail, `App/SwiftHFRTests/TopicListToolbarTests.swift:57`: the doc comment ends "Today the refresh button does.", which is no longer true once this PR lands and will mislead the next reader. Fix: "Before #1206 the refresh button did."
2. Detail, GAP-713 (ledger block): the row's `Lot/Feat` cell still reads `LOT-147, #681`, while its final cell now cites #1206. Fix (optional): add `Lot/Feat: LOT-147, #681, #1206` to the gap-edit.

Other uses of the button checked: `canRefresh` has no remaining caller. `ToolbarRefreshIcon` is still used by `BookmarksView`, so keeping it is correct. The leftover `Synchronization` import was rightly dropped with the deleted test. No other doc describes a refresh button in the topic-list top bar: the remaining "Actualiser" mentions are the reader, profile, AQ, bookmarks, the empty or error state buttons, and legacy descriptions.

**Vérifié**
- Head `f8c6eb2b` fetched; full PR diff `origin/dev-swift...f8c6eb2b` read (6 files).
- `ledger.py check-body --pr 1208` on the live body: "2 block(s) ok".
- Current GAP-025 and GAP-713 rows compared with their gap-edits.
- `git grep` of `docs/` and `App/` for Actualiser, refresh button, `canRefresh` and `ToolbarRefreshIcon`.
- `swiftlint lint --strict` on the 4 touched Swift files in a throwaway worktree: clean (worktree removed).
- Tests not run (Linux): settle logic and red/green reasoned by hand only.
